Covers highway-v0 only: the first card entry symbol, bark_ml.environments.gym:ContinuousHighwayGym (gym.py:25-36, registered at gym.py:155-157). The other card entry symbols (highway-v1, merging-v0, merging-medium-v0, merging-v1, intersection-v0, intersection-v1, singlelane-v0) are separate environments and are not covered. The fake is a pure Python kinematic stand-in for the 22-value NearestObserver observation and the two-float continuous action; it does not model BARK round-road geometry, IDM/MOBIL traffic, collisions, the goal polygon, the reward-shaping evaluator, scenario generation or reset seeds. The observation keeps the full 22-value layout, not a shrunken array; the sixth ego value is the raw lane-corridor index, which can be outside the observer's declared [0,1] Box, as upstream code also puts it there (nearest_observer.hpp:100-109, :170-176). The sim backend (gym.make) and the upstream package were not installed or run; bark-ml needs the compiled bark-simulator extension, gym, the registration import and a display because ContinuousHighwayGym always renders (gym.py:35-36). The package was checked on the fake backend only; no hardware exists for a simulator and no hardware run is claimed. Expected warnings, not cleared because the bridge derives these inputs: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the bridge handles the seed without a native call) and G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived seed, ticks and action.values inputs (PLAYBOOK.md section 8). G4.REF_VALUE and G4.REF_BINARY warnings: none. Model-authored and unreviewed; reviewed_by is null.
